name: sparktutor
description: 交互式 Apache Spark 4.1 学习环境，由 AI 导师辅助教学

sparktutor.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter with sparktutor installed

sparktutor.projectPath.description: Path to the sparktutor project root (containing src/sparktutor/). Leave empty for auto-detection.

sparktutor.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-powered code review and chat. Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.

sparktutor.claudeModel.description: Claude model to use for code review and chat

sparktutor.autoCloseTabs.description: Automatically close exercise tabs from the previous course when switching courses

sparktutor.lakehouseStackPath.description: Path to shared lakehouse stack (e.g. ~/lakehouse-stack). Used for courses requiring Spark/Kafka services. Leave empty to use per-course docker-compose.

enumDescriptions: Use Anthropic API directly (requires API key)
Use VS Code Copilot (GitHub Copilot subscription required)
Use any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Alibaba Qwen, Moonshot Kimi, Volcengine Doubao, Ollama, ...)
Auto: Anthropic if API key set, else OpenAI-compatible if configured, else Copilot if available, else local-only
sparktutor.aiProvider.description: Which AI provider to use for code review and chat

sparktutor.openaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. Examples: DeepSeek https://api.deepseek.com/v1, Zhipu GLM https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4, Alibaba Qwen https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, Moonshot Kimi https://api.moonshot.cn/v1, Volcengine Doubao https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3, Ollama http://localhost:11434/v1

sparktutor.openaiApiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible provider. Leave empty to use SPARKTUTOR_OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

sparktutor.openaiModel.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible provider. Examples: deepseek-chat, glm-4-plus, qwen-plus, moonshot-v1-8k, doubao-seed-1-6-250615, or an Ollama model name.

sparktutor.openaiExtraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers (JSON object) sent to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. for x-api-key authentication or a custom Authorization header. Overrides the default Bearer auth when present.

sparktutor.copilotModel.description: Preferred GitHub Copilot model id or family (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave empty to auto-select.

enumDescriptions: Run Spark locally (pip install pyspark, no Docker needed)
Run via lakehouse-stack Docker containers (Kafka, Iceberg)
Run on a Databricks cluster via Spark Connect
Auto-detect: lakehouse if container running, otherwise local

sparktutor.databricksClusterId.description: Databricks cluster ID to connect to

sparktutor.databricksProfile.description: Databricks config profile name from ~/.databrickscfg (alternative to host/token/cluster)
